title: Contribution Returned-Item Fee
content:
Returned-item fee rule (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)

**Applies to:** the payoff case of an Approved Short Sale Payoff requested by the borrower of record; the contribution returned-item fee forms part of the seller closing contribution.

**Rule.** The contribution returned-item fee is USD 35.00, the returned check fee, when any payoff funds return on the case was a cashier's check, and USD 25.00, the recalled wire fee, when the case carries a returned wire and no returned cashier's check; a case with neither carries nothing (0.00).

**Truth table.**

| Returned cashier's check on the case | Returned wire on the case | Contribution returned-item fee |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | USD 35.00 |
| no | yes | USD 25.00 |
| no | no | nothing |
